# Provider setup

<!-- Generated by acr docs propose-reference. Do not edit directly. -->
Source digest: `a7e63d6c059e144011fd3f8bafe64a2412a2f098f99dc79d08fcc584715ec65b`

The deterministic core needs no model provider.

## Local Ollama

```powershell
$env:ACR_PROVIDER = "ollama"
$env:ACR_OLLAMA_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
$env:ACR_OLLAMA_MODEL = "your-local-model"
python -m acr_runtime.cli doctor --json
```

Ollama defaults to loopback and a remote endpoint requires an explicit provider override. Model capabilities are discovered before routing.

## Deterministic tests

`MockProvider` supplies offline chat, streaming, embedding, capability, and token-accounting contracts. CI does not require paid API keys.

Never place credentials in CLI arguments, generated documentation, memory, or provider metadata. Use the governed secret-reference and exact-capability pathways.
